section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Australia AML regulations

propositions.proposition: AML/CTF法案要求报告实体实施并维护反洗钱/反恐怖融资合规计划，包括风险评估、内控、员工培训和独立审查。
source_quotes: The primary legislation governing AML/CFT in Australia is the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2006 (AML/CTF Act 2006).

This act requires reporting entities to implement and maintain an AML/CFT compliance program. This program includes risk assessment, internal controls for CDD and regulatory reporting, employee training, and independent reviews.

outcomes_or_paths: 包括风险评估、内控、员工培训和独立审查

evidence_spans.quote: The primary legislation governing AML/CFT in Australia is the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2006 (AML/CTF Act 2006).

This act requires reporting entities to implement and maintain an AML/CFT compliance program. This program includes risk assessment, internal controls for CDD and regulatory reporting, employee training, and independent reviews.

propositions.proposition: 修正案将反洗钱/反恐怖融资义务扩展至DNFBPs，包括识别验证客户、持续监控和报告可疑活动。
source_quotes: Extending AML/CFT obligations to DNFBPs, such as real estate agents, legal professionals, accountants, and dealers in precious metals and stones. This includes the obligations to identify and verify customers, conduct ongoing monitoring, and report suspicious activities to AUSTRAC.

outcomes_or_paths: 识别验证客户、持续监控、向AUSTRAC报告可疑活动

evidence_spans.quote: Extending AML/CFT obligations to DNFBPs, such as real estate agents, legal professionals, accountants, and dealers in precious metals and stones. This includes the obligations to identify and verify customers, conduct ongoing monitoring, and report suspicious activities to AUSTRAC.

propositions.proposition: 修正案授予AUSTRAC增强执法权，包括对违规实体处以更高罚款、发出补救指示以及提起民事或刑事诉讼。
source_quotes: Granting AUSTRAC enhanced enforcement powers, including the ability to impose higher penalties for noncompliance, issue remedial directions, and pursue civil and criminal actions against entities that breach AML/CFT obligations.

outcomes_or_paths: 处以更高罚款、发出补救指示、提起民事或刑事诉讼

evidence_spans.quote: Granting AUSTRAC enhanced enforcement powers, including the ability to impose higher penalties for noncompliance, issue remedial directions, and pursue civil and criminal actions against entities that breach AML/CFT obligations.

propositions.proposition: 修正案强调风险为本方法，允许实体根据识别的风险水平定制反洗钱/反恐怖融资措施，以确保资源有效配置。
source_quotes: Emphasizing the risk-based approach, allowing entities to tailor their AML/CFT measures based on the level of risk identified. This approach ensures that resources are allocated effectively to mitigate higher-risk areas.

outcomes_or_paths: 确保资源有效配置以缓解高风险领域

evidence_spans.quote: Emphasizing the risk-based approach, allowing entities to tailor their AML/CFT measures based on the level of risk identified. This approach ensures that resources are allocated effectively to mitigate higher-risk areas.

propositions.proposition: 新加坡采用风险为本反洗钱/反恐怖融资合规方法，要求金融机构和DNFBPs实施客户尽职调查、强化尽职调查、持续交易监控和可疑交易报告。
source_quotes: Singapore follows a risk-based approach to AML/CFT compliance. This approach requires financial institutions and DNFBPs to implement CDD, enhanced due diligence for high-risk clients, ongoing transaction monitoring, and suspicious transaction reporting.

outcomes_or_paths: 客户尽职调查、强化尽职调查、持续监控、可疑交易报告

evidence_spans.quote: Singapore follows a risk-based approach to AML/CFT compliance. This approach requires financial institutions and DNFBPs to implement CDD, enhanced due diligence for high-risk clients, ongoing transaction monitoring, and suspicious transaction reporting.

propositions.proposition: 《腐败、贩毒和其他严重犯罪（没收利益）法》将洗钱定为犯罪并规定可疑交易报告义务。
source_quotes: The Corruption, Drug Trafficking and Other Serious Crimes (Confiscation of Benefits) Act 1992: Criminalizes money laundering and mandates reporting of suspicious transactions.

outcomes_or_paths: 规定可疑交易报告义务

evidence_spans.quote: The Corruption, Drug Trafficking and Other Serious Crimes (Confiscation of Benefits) Act 1992: Criminalizes money laundering and mandates reporting of suspicious transactions.

propositions.proposition: 《恐怖主义（制止资助）法》将恐怖融资定为犯罪并加以预防。
source_quotes: The Terrorism (Suppression of Financing) Act 2002: Addresses the criminalization and prevention of terrorism financing.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 将恐怖融资定为犯罪并预防

evidence_spans.quote: The Terrorism (Suppression of Financing) Act 2002: Addresses the criminalization and prevention of terrorism financing.

propositions.proposition: 修正案修改泄密条款，以促进监管机构、执法机构和国际同行之间的信息共享。
source_quotes: Amending tipping off provisions to facilitate greater information sharing between regulatory bodies, law enforcement agencies, and international counterparts.

outcomes_or_paths: 促进监管机构、执法机构和国际同行之间的信息共享

evidence_spans.quote: Amending tipping off provisions to facilitate greater information sharing between regulatory bodies, law enforcement agencies, and international counterparts.

gap_evidence.gap_reason: 已有候选 s1c_003 承接了 AUSTRAC 增强执法权，但未承接此项关于促进信息共享的泄密条款修改。

propositions.proposition: 立法要求实体在2026年3月前遵守新义务。
source_quotes: Legislation requires entities to comply with the new obligations by 2026.
Reporting entities will be required to comply with many of the new obligations by March 2026.
